A_consensus_consumption.semantics: consumes the closed unanimous consensus ONLY through a trusted-launcher dispatch (lib/delivery/evidence.js createLaunchAuthority — Runner.Dispatch.v1 local equivalent, NOT modified): launcher integrity verification (fake origin FORGED_DISPATCH/MALFORMED_DISPATCH), builder identity conflict, artifactDigest bound to dispatch (ARTIFACT_DIGEST_MISMATCH — a one-shot authorization never covers other material), then the real mechanical judgment decides (participants fully covered / zero rejections / zero blockers / finalize report present / grill closed all live in judgeArchitectureGate refusals which pass through unchanged under CONSENSUS_NOT_ADMITTED — consumption never overrides the judgment)

T_oracle_strength.semantics: consumes ONE independent test design review: sufficiency conclusion must be affirmative and written; attested oracle strength must be strong|adequate (weak/unknown/missing → ORACLE_STRENGTH_REFUSED, routes back to test author); self-review by the authoring execution and builder identity refused; the dispatch must bind the CURRENT candidate (STALE_AUTHORIZATION — the original one-shot outbound authorization never covers new material) and the review must cite it (REVIEW_MATERIAL_MISMATCH). No quorum surface exists by construction — a single review object is the whole input; T is never extended to the three-party consensus

monotonic_revision.semantics: consumption-side anti-revival composed without new mechanism: (1) restore-old-bytes never re-consumes — the old consensus forwarded under the new revision's name is refused by REVIEW_REVISION_MISMATCH through consumeArchitectureGate even when the restored digest matches the still-valid dispatch binding; (2) a new revision re-reviews cold on its own real ballots and re-binds a NEW dispatch (fresh tally/report digests, nothing inherited); (3) old callbacks/old attempts never revive — seat STALE_ATTEMPT (late attempt-1 result after re-ballot), STALE_REVIEW (superseded manifest result), REVISION_REGRESSION (revision must strictly increase); downstream bound evidence invalidation reuses lib/delivery/baseline.js invalidateOnScopeChange unmodified
